transformer.title: Pinecone (Rag)

transformerIn.description: The QueryResponseWithUnsignedIndices of a QUERY or QUERY_BY_ID, or the List of ScoredVectorWithUnsignedIndices of its matches, with the text in the text_segment metadata, which the query returns with the CamelPineconeQueryIncludeMetadata header set to true. A match without the text gives an empty String, and a null body an empty List
